name: IRF9540N
description: P-channel enhancement power MOSFET in TO-220, -100V / -23A, 0.117 ohm Rds(on). The common complement to the N-channel IRF540N for high-side switching and motor/H-bridge drive. Fully avalanche rated.

pins.name: G
pins.description: gate; drive negative relative to source (Vgs below Vgs(th)) to turn on

pins.name: D
pins.description: drain; connected to the metal tab

pins.name: S
pins.description: source; tie to the positive rail in high-side use (body-diode cathode)

typical_application: High-side switching, the P-channel side of H-bridges and complementary push-pull stages, reverse-polarity protection, and load switching from a positive rail.
gotchas: P-channel: all voltages are negative. source goes to the positive supply; turn on by pulling the gate negative relative to source (more negative than Vgs(th), ~-2 to -4V; drive with about -10V)
gate is referenced to source, not ground; in high-side use the source sits near V+, so the gate must be driven below that rail, not just to ground
the metal tab is Drain and is electrically live; isolate it from heatsinks/chassis
higher Rds(on) and lower current than a same-size N-channel part (lower hole mobility); body diode points drain-to-source, opposite an N-channel device
